description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag for generating download URLs for digital products in an admin interface. It constructs a URL based on merchant store configuration, session attributes, and product details.

classes.name: AdminProductDownloadUrlTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag for dynamically generating download URLs for digital products, using store and product context.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates a download URL for a digital product based on request, session, and store configuration, and writes it to the page output.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the custom tag processing, returning EVAL_PAGE.

methods.name: setDigitalProduct
methods.description: Sets the digital product to generate a download URL for.
